figure: 2x3 forest: WMSE, WR2(delta ctrl), Pearson(delta pert), MSE, Pearson(delta ctrl), NIR

cohort.genecompass_mean: same file as its scores; WMSE column only
cohort.scfoundation_note: fixed 1802 minus NBAS; Mean is that file's mean on the same 1801 keys
cohort.gene_axis: Technical duplicate, Interpolated duplicate, and Control mean stay on the 8370-gene GEARS author_formal scores, paired to the 8369-gene fixed Mean. Other rows and that Mean use 8369 genes.

delta_definition: Except panel c: score(model) - score(dataset mean), paired on fold and condition. Each row uses the Mean on that row's own keys. Five folds are pooled. A row is omitted, not trimmed, if its scores are not finite on every perturbation of its cohort.

c_pearson_deltapert.why_not_delta: Dataset-mean Pearson(delta pert) is NaN on every perturbation. A constant mean prediction has no delta-pert variance, so the correlation is undefined. NaN was not imputed as zero. This matches Miller et al. 2026 MOESM4 Results table cells I14 and I28, which are '-'.

omitted: control: Pearson(delta ctrl) undefined on every perturbation; MOESM4 Results table H13 and H27 are '-'

statistics.center: mean of the per-perturbation values used in that panel
statistics.seed: numpy SeedSequence([42, metric index, roster index]); one generator per row, not the old single-panel sequential stream
statistics.bonferroni: raw p times the number of rows drawn in that panel, capped at 1. Not the previous 11-comparison adjustment rewritten as 19.
statistics.underflow: a raw p that underflows to 0 is drawn as P<10^{-300}
statistics.wmse_check: WMSE paired means match the previous 19-row WMSE forest to 1e-9. Intervals were recomputed.
